_doc: Tuning for the geo_tile@v1 bake (T-003). Every value cites its source; changing any value changes the bake fingerprint.

datum._src: NOAA CO-OPS 9414290 datums (R-004 §2.3); values recomputed from the fetched datums file at bake time and checked against these

terrain._src: R-004 §1.2 merge rule: 3DEP 1 m where valid and CUDEM > +1.798 m NAVD88 (R-004 text 'MHW (+1.80 m)', i.e. MHHW), CUDEM elsewhere, linear feather.
terrain._blend_note: Fix cycle 2 (M-005@v1.1 M-005.9: the blend may add steps of p99 <= 0.20 m, max <= 0.50 m). Measured on L0_30_36 (excess step E p99 / max; C10 median MSL-crossing offset from the OSM coastline): inside-only 10 m (R-004) 0.276 / 0.489, C10 2.5 m; inside-only 14 m 0.196 / 0.350, C10 5.0 m; inside-only 20 m 0.129 / 0.245, C10 5.5 m (fails C10 <= 5 m: CUDEM's smeared shoreline replaces 3DEP's where 3DEP marks water); centred 40 m 0.196 / 0.486, C10 1.5 m; centred 50 m 0.172 / 0.396, C10 1.5 m (chosen). Centred = weight 0.5 at the region edge, blending also 25 m seaward wherever both sources are valid (mostly hydro-flattened 3DEP water at -1.07 m: near-shore seabed within 25 m of the 3DEP land edge moves toward that value, reported in EVIDENCE.md).

edge_donors._src: T-106c, M-005 terrain_seam_all_edges: a tile also reads the cached 3DEP windows of its 8 neighbours that reach within reach_m of its grid (192 m margin + 50 m blend fade), so the two sides of a shared edge see the same projects. Set enabled=false to restore the T-103 bytes.

water._src: R-004 §1.5: OSM water polygons AND surface < MSL; piers and building footprints are never water
water.pier_deck_rule: piers (OSM man_made=pier) are solid: inside a pier polygon the surface is raised (never lowered) to a flat deck = the median of 3DEP samples above MHHW on the pier when >= pier_min_deck_samples exist, else the 75th percentile of dry 3DEP land within 40 m of the pier (its root)

lidar_fill._src: T-020b: only for buildings whose height_source is default; median of (first-return p95 - terrain) over 1 m cells in the footprint eroded erode_m; needs >= min_coverage of those cells with returns; mean multi-return share above max_multi_return_share = vegetation, rejected (Assumed thresholds)

low_floor._src: M1 lead session 3: a clear measurement (coverage >= min_coverage, multi-return share <= max) below min_height_m sets min_height_m (low sheds, earth-covered batteries) instead of the 3-level default (Assumed)

overlap._src: T-106c, M-005 collider_overlap (R-100 0.05 m2): OSM has overlapping footprints (a relation and its own outer ways, a large low shed under three houses, a podium under a tower). Set enabled=false to restore the T-003 bytes.

assessor._src: T-020 add-on, R-021 Q-NEW-b: optional additive year_built/stories/struct_class from the Assessor roll, parcel centroid point-in-footprint (smallest containing footprint wins)

roads._src: R-004 §1.5: width = lanes x 3.5 m, else a class default (Assumed values: typical US lane/sidewalk widths)
